cat > stereo.py << 'EOF'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Chem.EnumerateStereoisomers import EnumerateStereoisomers, StereoEnumerationOptions

def build():
    els = ['C','C','C','C','C','C','O','C','N','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','O','O','C','C','N','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C']
    mol = Chem.RWMol()
    for e in els: mol.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(e))
    AR=Chem.BondType.AROMATIC; S=Chem.BondType.SINGLE; D=Chem.BondType.DOUBLE
    bonds=[(0,1,AR),(1,2,AR),(2,3,AR),(3,4,AR),(4,5,AR),(5,0,AR),(2,11,AR),(11,9,AR),(9,8,AR),(8,3,AR),
     (8,10,S),(4,6,S),(6,7,S),(11,12,S),(12,13,S),(13,14,S),(14,28,S),(28,25,S),(25,24,S),(24,23,S),(23,21,S),(21,9,S),
     (21,20,S),(20,13,S),(20,14,S),(20,22,S),(25,26,D),(26,27,S),(14,15,S),(15,16,D),(15,17,S),(17,18,S),(18,19,S)]
    for a,b,t in bonds: mol.AddBond(a,b,t)
    m=mol.GetMol()
    for i in [0,1,2,3,4,5,8,9,11]: m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).SetIsAromatic(True)
    nb=m.GetAtomWithIdx(20); nb.SetFormalCharge(1); nb.SetNoImplicit(True); nb.SetNumExplicitHs(0)
    na=m.GetAtomWithIdx(8); na.SetNoImplicit(True); na.SetNumExplicitHs(0)
    for i in [2,3,9,11,4]: m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).SetNoImplicit(True); m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).SetNumExplicitHs(0)
    Chem.SanitizeMol(m, Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_ALL ^ Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_PROPERTIES)
    return m

m0=build()
# target 2D (x,y) for indole alignment atoms
pos={0:(253,21),1:(379,32),2:(425,141),3:(350,240),4:(231,228),5:(185,116),8:(415,336),9:(535,302),11:(535,178)}
indole=sorted(pos.keys())
B=np.array([[pos[i][0], -pos[i][1], 0.0] for i in indole])  # y flip, z=0
B=B-B.mean(axis=0)

# wedge specs: (center, neighbor_selector, sigma) sigma=+1 toward, -1 behind
# neighbor_selector: 'H' (the attached H) or heavy atom index
spec=[(13,'H',-1),(21,'H',-1),(24,'H',+1),(14,15,-1),(20,22,-1)]

def kabsch_z(mh):
    conf=mh.GetConformer()
    A=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in indole])
    Ac=A-A.mean(axis=0)
    H=Ac.T@B
    U,Sv,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    R=Vt.T@U.T
    if np.linalg.det(R)<0:
        Vt[-1]*=-1; R=Vt.T@U.T
    N=mh.GetNumAtoms()
    P=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(N)])
    Pc=P-A.mean(axis=0)
    Pt=Pc@R.T
    return Pt  # aligned coords (indole in xy-plane matching target)

def score(mh):
    Pt=kabsch_z(mh)
    s=0; detail=[]
    for c,sel,sig in spec:
        if sel=='H':
            hs=[n.GetIdx() for n in mh.GetAtomWithIdx(c).GetNeighbors() if n.GetAtomicNum()==1]
            if not hs: continue
            j=hs[0]
        else:
            j=sel
        dz=Pt[j,2]-Pt[c,2]
        ok = (dz*sig>0)
        s+= 1 if ok else 0
        detail.append((c,j,round(dz,2),sig,ok))
    return s,detail,Pt

opts=StereoEnumerationOptions(onlyUnassigned=True, unique=True, maxIsomers=256)
isos=list(EnumerateStereoisomers(m0, options=opts))
print("num stereoisomers:", len(isos))
best=None
for k,iso in enumerate(isos):
    mh=Chem.AddHs(iso)
    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=1000+k; ps.useMacrocycleTorsions=False
    if AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh, ps)!=0: 
        continue
    try:
        AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=150)
    except Exception as e:
        pass
    s,detail,Pt=score(mh)
    # ethylidene: after alignment, positions of 27(Me) and 24(W-substituent on Z) relative to 25=26 axis
    smi=Chem.MolToSmiles(iso)
    if best is None or s>best[0]:
        best=(s,smi,detail,Pt,mh)
    if s>=5:
        print("ISO",k,"score",s,smi)
        for d in detail: print("   ",d)
print("BEST score",best[0], best[1])
for d in best[2]: print("   ",d)
Chem.MolToXYZFile(best[4], "best.xyz")
print("wrote best.xyz; atoms", best[4].GetNumAtoms())
EOF

cat > select.py << 'EOF'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from chem_build import build
from rdkit.Chem.EnumerateStereoisomers import EnumerateStereoisomers, StereoEnumerationOptions

m0=build()
pos={0:(253,21),1:(379,32),2:(425,141),3:(350,240),4:(231,228),5:(185,116),8:(415,336),9:(535,302),11:(535,178)}
indole=sorted(pos.keys())
B=np.array([[pos[i][0],-pos[i][1],0.0] for i in indole]); B=B-B.mean(0)
spec=[(13,'H',-1),(21,'H',-1),(14,15,-1),(20,22,-1)]

def align(mh):
    conf=mh.GetConformer()
    A=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in indole]); Ac=A-A.mean(0)
    U,Sv,Vt=np.linalg.svd(Ac.T@B); R=Vt.T@U.T
    if np.linalg.det(R)<0: Vt[-1]*=-1; R=Vt.T@U.T
    P=np.array([list(conf.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in range(mh.GetNumAtoms())])
    return (P-A.mean(0))@R.T

def dihedral(p,i,j,k,l):
    b0=p[i]-p[j]; b1=p[k]-p[j]; b2=p[l]-p[k]
    b1=b1/np.linalg.norm(b1)
    v=b0-np.dot(b0,b1)*b1; w=b2-np.dot(b2,b1)*b1
    x=np.dot(v,w); y=np.dot(np.cross(b1,v),w)
    return np.degrees(np.arctan2(y,x))

opts=StereoEnumerationOptions(onlyUnassigned=True,unique=True,maxIsomers=64)
isos=list(EnumerateStereoisomers(m0,options=opts))
rows=[]
for k,iso in enumerate(isos):
    mh=Chem.AddHs(iso)
    ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=7; ps.maxIterations=2000
    if AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,ps)!=0: 
        rows.append((-1,k,Chem.MolToSmiles(iso),None,None)); continue
    Pt=align(mh)
    sc=0; det=[]
    for c,sel,sig in spec:
        if sel=='H':
            hs=[n.GetIdx() for n in mh.GetAtomWithIdx(c).GetNeighbors() if n.GetAtomicNum()==1]
            j=hs[0]
        else: j=sel
        dz=Pt[j,2]-Pt[c,2]
        ok=dz*sig>0; sc+=ok; det.append((c,round(dz,2),ok))
    dih=dihedral(Pt,28,25,26,27)
    isE = abs(dih)>90
    rows.append((sc,k,Chem.MolToSmiles(iso),round(dih,1),det))
rows.sort(key=lambda r:(-r[0], -(1 if (r[3] is not None and abs(r[3])>90) else 0)))
for r in rows[:12]:
    print("score",r[0],"iso",r[1],"dih28-25-26-27",r[3],r[2])
    print("   det",r[4])

import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from chem_build import build
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

m=build()
# full target 2D positions for heavy atoms (x, y_down)
pos={0:(253,21),1:(379,32),2:(425,141),3:(350,240),4:(231,228),5:(185,116),
 6:(190,300),7:(70,330),8:(415,336),9:(535,302),10:(330,455),11:(535,178),
 12:(640,117),13:(745,175),14:(870,175),15:(1000,120),16:(965,55),17:(1080,150),18:(1150,115),19:(1190,180),
 20:(750,305),21:(640,360),22:(630,230),23:(640,480),24:(745,540),25:(840,480),26:(950,540),27:(960,655),28:(845,360)}
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,(x,y) in pos.items():
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i, Point3D(float(x), float(-y), 0.0))
# stereochemical nudges (z in Angstrom; drawing plane = xy, +z toward viewer)
# dashed/behind groups get z<0 ; nudge stereocenters toward (+) so their H goes behind
zset={13:+0.6, 21:+0.6, 15:-1.0, 22:-1.0, 14:+0.3, 20:+0.3}
for i,z in zset.items():
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i); conf.SetAtomPosition(i, Point3D(p.x,p.y,float(z)))
m.AddConformer(conf)
# place hydrogens from this heavy-atom conformer
mh=Chem.AddHs(m, addCoords=True)
# force the two carbinol H's (on 13 and 21) to be behind (z<0): adjust them explicitly
conf=mh.GetConformer()
for c in (13,21):
    for n in mh.GetAtomWithIdx(c).GetNeighbors():
        if n.GetAtomicNum()==1:
            hp=conf.GetAtomPosition(c)
            conf.SetAtomPosition(n.GetIdx(), Point3D(hp.x, hp.y, hp.z-1.1))
# relax with force field (keeps configuration)
ok=False
try:
    p=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mh, mmffVariant='MMFF94')
    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, mmffVariant='MMFF94', maxIters=3000); ok=True
    print("MMFF ok")
except Exception as e:
    print("MMFF fail:",e)
if not ok:
    AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=3000); print("UFF ok")
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mh, confId=0)
print("centers:", Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mh, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(mh))
Chem.MolToXYZFile(mh,"best.xyz")
print("wrote best.xyz, atoms", mh.GetNumAtoms())
EOF
